in_sanskrit.name: Bindusar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Droplets of Saraswati
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bindusar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bindusar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bindu' meaning drop and 'saraswati' meaning Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. This name signifies the one who is full of wisdom and knowledge, just like the drops of water that fall from Saraswati's vessel. Bindusar is a revered name in Hindu culture, especially among those who value learning and knowledge.
